note: Allowed nouns and phrase pools for percepts (DESIGN.md section 7). Phrase pools are filled by WP2; every state change needs at least three paraphrases.

hunger_growing: Your middle aches, and it grows stronger.
The ache grows; your middle feels hollow.
hunger_empty: Your arms and legs shake; your middle aches.
Your head feels light; your middle aches sharply.
Your legs shake, and your middle aches.
eating: Sweet fills your mouth; your middle eases.
Sweet in your mouth; the ache in your middle softens.
Your mouth tastes sweet, and your middle eases.
injury: A hard hurt in your side.
Your side hurts sharply where it was struck.
Your arm hurts; the hurt stays.
fatigue: Your legs feel slow; your eyes sink shut.
Your arms and legs feel heavy; your eyes are hard to keep open.
company: Near a one like you, your middle eases.
A one close by; your arms and legs feel less tense.
With a one nearby, your middle feels calm.
solitude: No one is near; restlessness grows inside you.
The ground around you stays empty; you feel a pull toward a one.
Quiet stays around you; you want a one nearby.
stillness: You see the still one; your side feels cold.
The one lies quiet and unmoving; cold settles in your middle.
You look at the unmoving one; your arms feel heavy.
fear: Your head pounds; your feet press into the ground.
Your arms tense; your feet press into the ground.
Your legs tense; you feel pulled to move away.
light: The light is bright; your eyes narrow.
Light falls across the ground, clear and strong.
The light fades; the shapes ahead grow dim.
weather: The sky is clear, and the wind is still.
Wind moves the grass across the ground.
The sky darkens; cool wind passes over your head.
